title: Redefine loading gesture and icon hitbox behavior to fix high-DPI regression and unify affordances
creator: Marina Ortega
description: Background: After the theme token migration and the recent compact-mode update, engineering shipped a patch that unintentionally reduced icon-only button hitboxes on some high-DPI displays and introduced inconsistent loading affordances between 'ghost' and 'primary' variants. This ticket defines the proposed design spec and handoff to fix the regression, unify loading/disabled gestures, and document token changes.
problem_statement: 1) Icon-only buttons on macOS Retina and some Linux HiDPI environments have a reduced active area, causing missed taps. 2) Loading states diverge across variants: some use a full-button spinner overlay while others switch only the icon. 3) Theme switch (light/dark/expressive) results in inconsistent spinner contrast and jitter during asynchronous transitions.
design_goals:
- Restore consistent minimum hitbox (44x44px target) across variants and breakpoints.
- Define a single loading gesture pattern: replace actionable content with a composable spinner + label skeleton where appropriate; keep icon-only buttons showing a centered spinner.
- Ensure spinner and overlay use semantic tokens so contrast and motion persist across themes.
- Avoid layout shifts: use reserved space/kindred placeholders to prevent width jumps for icon+label compound buttons.
accepted_tradeoffs:
- We will prefer a slightly larger visual hitbox (padding) for compact icon buttons rather than changing global spacing scales. This keeps spacing tokens stable for other components.
- For transient micro-animations (100–220ms), we cap motion to 220ms to avoid perceived sluggishness on slow backends.
- We will not change primary typography metrics in this ticket to keep release scope small.
engineering_notes:
- Frontend: see GH PR #4512 for initial patch. Implementation should use CSS variables for token driven colors and a dedicated .rw-button--loading modifier.
- Runtime: avoid remounting content on loading; swap visible content via opacity/transform with will-change to preserve layout.
- Provide a small JS helper to enable 'delayed spinner' behavior (start spinner after 180ms to avoid flicker on sub-200ms ops).
- Add unit tests for pointer events and hitbox size at 1x, 1.5x, 2x pixel ratios.
- Backend: no changes required.
Links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4512
accessibility_notes:
- Keyboard target size must meet 44px minimum; add aria-busy on loading buttons.
- Spinner must include aria-hidden=true and a visually-hidden 'Loading' label for screen readers when content is replaced.
- Verify focus styles persist when a button enters loading state (focus ring should remain visible).
acceptance_criteria: Icon-only and icon+label buttons have a 44x44px interactive target on all tested DPRs
Loading state uses tokenized spinner with sufficient contrast in light/dark/expressive themes
No visual width jump for compound buttons when entering/exiting loading
E2E coverage: keyboard navigation into loading buttons, screen-reader announcement of aria-busy
Regression fixed: previous hitbox reduction on high-DPI displays reproducer no longer fails
qa_plan: Manual: reproduce previous bug on macOS Retina (Chrome/Safari) and Linux HiDPI (Chrome/Firefox)
Automated: add visual regression snapshots for compact icon buttons at DPR 1x/1.5x/2x
Performance: measure perceived latency with delayed-spinner enabled vs disabled

decisions: Adopt 44x44px minimum touch target for all interactive icons (mobile and desktop).
Use delayed spinner at 180ms default with config override.
Spinner color and backdrop will map to semantic tokens: component-surface/primary-on/secondary-on as appropriate.

implementation_risks:
- Overlapping token names with the recent migration could cause build-time overrides; require a tokens mapping file.
- Motion additives could introduce jank if not GPU-accelerated; ensure transform/opacity usage.
- Browser DPI detection is quirky—rely on CSS pixel ratios rather than userAgent heuristics.
final_notes: Aim for a narrow, well-tested change set that fixes the regression and standardizes affordances without broad layout/token churn. Handoff package must include tokens JSON, redlines, and a minimal demo page for QA.
